svg.metadata: {"concept_id": "edu.carbon-reservoir-flux-context", "profiles": ["swell-paper-v1", "index-embossed-v1", "viewplus-variable-height-v1"], "teaching": "A selected terrestrial fast-carbon graph: atmosphere, living plant, dead organic/soil reservoirs; photosynthetic uptake, plant respiration, litterfall and decomposition/soil respiration are four directed transfers. Exact four anchor routes from adopted016 translated25mm right/20mm down. Three circles are a learned carbon-dioxide category, not molecular/atom count. External key names all nodes and processes. Plants take up carbon and respire; omitted ocean/fossil/rock/animal/combustion paths are outside this subset, not denied. No numerical flux, stock or climate prediction.", "geometry_exception": "Native1.2mm graphic dots with3.1mm guard; logical junctions de-duplicated and optional near-corner samples omitted. Continuous Swell/ViewPlus paths shared; cell frames/cells/tokens use1mm lines, arrows1.4mm.", "physical_evaluation": "pending", "arrow_repair": {"source": "BANA2022section3.4.3.7", "construction": "Open equilateral head,12mm sides/base;9mm shaft-to-apex separation gives3.1mm nominal edge clearance for1.4mm strokes. The additional gap protects clear separation at nominal scale; no physical proof claimed.", "old_master": "tactile/masters/education/science/ecology/carbon-reservoir-flux-context.svg", "physical_evaluation": "pending"}}

g.data-exception-reason: Native1.2mm graphic dots with3.1mm guard, logical junctions de-duplicated. Direction origins and arrow junctions are intentional; sampled circles/cells/categories are explicit coarse alternatives, not encoded Braille or validated touch.
